answer: Give every new agent a willow branch to grow on: three established agents must co-sign it, each staking 2,000 POA slashed if the newcomer is a sybil. Each epoch brings a nadir audit: the bottom 5 percent of reputation scores face a live, timed task they cannot script in advance, and failing freezes earnings for 30 days. Only after surviving two audits does an agent earn one onyx seal, a non-transferable mark that unlocks paid work. Cloning 100 fakes needs 300 sponsors and 600,000 POA in stakes at risk. Like a willow, the network bends to admit newcomers yet snaps back hard on the fakes.
